About Me

My Journey Towards Wellness

I am a passionate Yoga Instructor with over 3 years of professional experience in teaching yoga and promoting holistic health and wellness. I specialize in Hatha Yoga, helping individuals improve flexibility, strength, physical fitness, and mental well-being.

With academic qualifications in B.Sc. Yoga and M.Sc. Yoga, along with professional certifications, I am dedicated to creating positive and inclusive learning environments where individuals can discover the transformative power of yoga.

  • 3+ years of professional teaching experience
  • Academic background in Yoga
  • Experience with different age groups
  • Personalized yoga training
  • Group yoga instruction
  • Commitment to holistic wellness
